'''Battle Droid C-11''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was an upgraded version of the [[Battle Droid C-10]] and was followed by the [[Battle Droid C-13]].
